items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: So it reads Milton Baptiste. Andrew Jefferson. Andy Anderson. David Grillier. Lester Collies.

ctx.x: And this is Lester Collies. Lester Collies. This guy's name is Edwards. Edwards. And I can't think of his first or last name. But he is. Nephew to the bass drummer. Who you can't see. Who is. Henry Glass I believe. And Henry is playing there. I don't know. I don't see him. So it could be his brother. I mean not his brother. His son Noel. But I can see the drum there. But I can't see the head. Over here is Andy Anderson. So it reads Milton Baptiste. Andrew Jefferson. Andy Anderson. David Grillier. Lester Collies.…
